news.title: Update on June 17 fire at K-State Dairy Unit
news.summary_en: Riley County Fire District #1 and the Manhattan Fire Department responded to reports of a structure fire near the K-State Dairy Unit early this morning. No people or animals were injured...

news.title: Kansas Board of Regents to meet June 17 and 18 in Topeka
news.summary_en: The Kansas Board of Regents meets Wednesday, June 17, and Thursday, June 18, at the Curtis State Office Building in Topeka.
